literal_meaning: হাত দিয়ে জল গলে না (water does not melt or flow away with the hand)
similar_in_english: holding onto money like a miser
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এতটাই কৃপণ যে হাত দিয়ে জল গলে না বলে মনে হয়, কখনো কাউকে সাহায্য করে না।
তার হাত দিয়ে জল গলে না, তাই বন্ধুদের জন্য খরচ করতে চায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is so stingy that it seems water doesn't melt with his hands; he never helps anyone.
Water doesn't melt with his hands, meaning he's too miserly to spend on friends.
note: This idiom metaphorically describes extreme reluctance to part with money or possessions, akin to water not easily slipping away.
